shape: GET /api/tracking-sink/rollups?by=strategy — one row per (strategy, intent, day)
why: strategyLearning.ts:142-144 reads row.strategy and row.intent with NO fallback of any kind, and weights every mean by row.n. The grain answered 503 from the day the consumer was written until kugel-data migration 012 built v_strategy_window; this fixture is what stops the column names drifting apart again now that both sides exist.
note: `n` is the weight. strategyLearning's rowCount treats a row with no n as weight 1 rather than dropping it, so losing this column would not fail -- it would let a four-session day outvote a four-thousand-session one. Only sessions, completion_rate and p75_dwell_ms are measured on this grain today; the rest are structurally 0 (kugel-data migration 012 header, ATTRIBUTION.md section 5). revenue_cents is not additive across strategy rows.
